plan.name: Systematically search cabinets and fridge for lettuce, then cool and place on countertop.
plan.strategy: Systematically search all likely storage locations (cabinets and fridge) for the lettuce, cool it if necessary, and then place it on the countertop.
steps: Check cabinet 1 to cabinet 6 systematically for lettuce.
If lettuce is not found in the cabinets, proceed to check fridge 1.
If lettuce is found, take it and check if it is already cool.
If lettuce is not cool, place it in the fridge to cool it.
Once lettuce is cool, move to a countertop (e.g., countertop 1) and place it there.
